question: From one start zone where the class allows it, how long does each class take to reach level 10?
note: Holds the start zone constant where the class allows it rather than the race: the start shapes levels 1-10 more than racials do. Coldridge Valley covers seven of the nine classes (Dwarf for Warrior, Paladin, Hunter, Rogue and Priest; Gnome for Mage and Warlock); the only Alliance shaman is a Draenei and the only Alliance druid a Night Elf. Death Knight is left out: the server creates one only on an account that already holds a level-55 character, and it starts at 55. The leash is race-probe@1's. Version 1 lived only in the fleet config and was edited in place while it ran, so it has no definition.

cells.note: The subscription lanes' scored start: the calibration cell.
The only Alliance shaman; starts in Ammen Vale.
The only Alliance druid; starts in Shadowglen.
